abilities.name: Demon Lieutenant
abilities.description: Summon a Demon Lieutenant at any allied Mercenary, Minion, or Azmodan Demon. The Lieutenant will cast Demonic Smite every 7 seconds, instantly killing an enemy Minion. Loses Health over 21 seconds. Usable while Channeling All Shall Burn. Demon Lieutenant Demonic Smite ; 60; trait

fields.notes: A Demon Lieutenant is unable to move or attack during its spawn duration. Deals 100% bonus damage to Mercenaries and Minions.

abilities.name: Globe Of Annihilation
abilities.description: Shoot a globe of destruction, dealing 176 damage on impact. Deals 50% damage to non-Heroes. Quest Hitting a Hero or killing a Minion within 3 seconds of being hit by Globe of Annihilation grants 2 stacks of Annihilation. Each stack increases its damage by 1. Reward After gaining 450 Annihilation, the area of Globe of Annihilation is increased by 15% and it deals 150 additional damage.

fields.notes: Azmodan is able to cast Summon Demon Warrior, Demon Lieutenant and Tide of Sin while casting this Ability. This ability deals full damage to summons. Increases radius by 15%, so the area is actually increased by 32%

abilities.name: Summon Demon Warrior
abilities.description: Spawn a Demon Warrior that marches forward. Warriors deal 53 damage per Attack. Loses Health over 17 seconds. Deals 100% bonus damage to Mercenaries and Minions. Stores up to 2 charges. Usable while Channeling All Shall Burn. Demon Warrior

fields.notes: A Demon Warrior is immobile, Invulnerable, and unable to move or attack during its spawn duration, though it will still block skillshots, negating them entirely during this time, and will instantly take Structure aggro off of Heroes during this spawn time (unless they have Call for Help triggered).

abilities.name: All Shall Burn
abilities.description: Channel a beam of death on an enemy, dealing 128 damage per second for 2.5 seconds. If the Channel lasts its full duration, deal an extra 340 damage to the target. Azmodan's Movement Speed is reduced by 30% while Channeling.; 6 / 1.0

fields.notes: The channel is interrupted if the target moves outside the active range. Can be reactivated after 1 second to end its effect early. Does not grant full duration benefits if interrupted in this way. Azmodan is able to cast Summon Demon Warrior, Demon Lieutenant, Demonic Invasion and Tide of Sin while casting and channeling this Ability.

abilities.name: Demonic Invasion
abilities.description: Rain a small army of Demonic Grunts down on enemies, dealing 85 damage per impact. Grunts deal 30 damage, have 750 Health and last up to 20 seconds. When Grunts die they explode, dealing 40 damage to nearby enemies, doubled against enemy Heroes. Usable while Channeling All Shall Burn. Demonic Grunt ; 100; 60; heroic

fields.notes: Demonic Grunts lose 75 (+4%/level) Health per second, causing any damage dealt to them to also reduce their duration.

abilities.name: Tide of Sin
abilities.description: Activate to make the next Globe of Annihilation cost no Mana and deal 50% more damage. Usable while Channeling All Shall Burn.; 20; 100; heroic

fields.notes: Stacks additively with other offensive damage modifiers affecting Globe of Annihilation 's damage. Can be cast while casting and channeling Globe of Annihilation and All Shall Burn.

talents.name: Greed
talents.description: Globe of Annihilation deals 15% more damage to non-Heroic targets. Questonly After gaining 225 Annihilation, increase the range of All Shall Burn by 25% and Demon Warriors gain 20% Attack Speed and Movement Speed. Globe of Annihilation's damage penalty against Minions and Mercenaries is removed.

talents.name: Gluttony
talents.description: Increase the number of stacks of Annihilation gained by hitting Heroes with Globe of Annihilation from 2 to 4. Questonly After gaining 225 Annihilation, each enemy hit by Globe of Annihilation reduces its cooldown by 0.25 seconds, doubled against Heroes. Globe of Annihilation's damage penalty against Minions and Mercenaries is removed.

talents.name: Wrath
talents.description: Every other Basic Attack against Heroes or Structures grants Annihilation. Questonly After gaining 225 Annihilation, hitting a Hero with Globe of Annihilation increases the damage of Azmodan's next Basic Attack against them within 3 seconds by 85% of the amount of Annihilation he has. Globe of Annihilation's damage penalty against Minions and Mercenaries is removed.

fields.notes: Annihilation is gained before the Basic Attack damage is dealt, increasing its damage if the Quest is complete and the Basic Attack would also be empowered by it. damage unaffected by q quest final reward.

talents.name: Battleborn
talents.description: Reduce the Mana cost of Summon Demon Warrior from 25 to 20. Azmodan's Basic Attacks reduce the cooldown of Summon Demon Warrior by 0.75 seconds and Demon Lieutenant by 1.5 seconds.
_raw_fields: Reduce the Mana cost of Summon Demon Warrior from 25 to 20. Azmodan's Basic Attacks reduce the cooldown of Summon Demon Warrior by 0.75 seconds and Demon Lieutenant by 1.5 seconds.

talents.name: Art of Chaos
talents.description: If Globe of Annihilation hits 2 or more Heroes, restore 40 Mana and gain an extra 2 Annihilation.
_raw_fields: If Globe of Annihilation hits 2 or more Heroes, restore 40 Mana and gain an extra 2 Annihilation.

talents.name: Bombardment
talents.description: After casting Globe of Annihilation, Azmodan's Basic Attacks within the next 3 seconds have an additional 1.5 range and can hit 3 additional targets. Hitting Heroes with Basic Attacks empowered by Bombardment grants 1 Annihilation.

fields.notes: The additional targets hit can grant stacks for the Wrath talent and receive its bonus damage, and also grant cooldown reduction for the Battleborn talent. Annihilation is gained before the Basic Attack damage is dealt (increasing its damage if Wrath 's Quest is complete and the Basic Attacks would also be empowered by it).

talents.name: Master of Destruction
talents.description: If All Shall Burn's channel kills or lasts its full duration, All Shall Burn's final damage applies to all enemies in an area around the target and grants 1 Annihilation per Hero hit.

fields.notes: Also triggers if the target dies to any other source of damage than All Shall Burn while its channel is active.

talents.description: Reduces the Channel time of All Shall Burn by 0.5 seconds. If All Shall Burn's Channel kills or lasts its full duration against a Hero, Azmodan is healed for 8% of his maximum Health.

fields.notes: Reduces periodic damage ticks by 2. Damage per tick remains unchanged, lowering the total damage of the Ability. Also triggers if the target dies to any other source of damage than All Shall Burn while its channel is active.

talents.name: Chain of Command
talents.description: The cooldown of Demon Lieutenants' Demonic Smite is reduced by 2 seconds and they grant 25% increased damage to nearby friendly Minions, Mercenaries, and Azmodan’s summoned Demons.

fields.notes: Does not increase the damage of Demon Lieutenant itself, but two Demon Lieutenants can potentially increase the damage of each other. Does not stack with itself. Stacks additively with other offensive damage modifiers affecting the target units' damage output.

talents.description: If All Shall Burn Channels for its full duration or kills the target, a Demon Warrior is summoned at the target's location and all Demon Warriors deal 35% increased damage for 5 seconds.

fields.notes: Also triggers if the target dies to any other source of damage than All Shall Burn while its channel is active. Affects both the Basic Attack damage and the burn aura damage of Demon Warriors. Stacks additively with other offensive damage modifiers affecting Demon Warriors' damage output.

talents.name: Sin's Grasp
talents.description: All Shall Burn Slows enemy Heroes. While active, the target is Slowed by 15%, and if it lasts its full duration, they are Slowed by 50% for 2.5 seconds. If All Shall Burn's channel kills or last its full duration against a Hero, reduce its cooldown by 50%.

fields.notes: Also triggers if the target dies to any other source of damage than All Shall Burn while its channel is active. A full duration channel only triggers these effects if the target is an enemy Hero.
